title: New ways to manage your data in ChatGPT
author: OpenAI / Modelverse Editorial
excerpt: ChatGPT users can now turn off chat history, allowing you to choose which conversations can be used to train our models....
body:
ChatGPT users can now turn off chat history, allowing you to choose which conversations can be used to train our models.
